signal: Tricerat appointed Hannah Shuman as President and CEO, shipped ScrewDrivers 7.8 with granular RBAC, and joined IGEL Ready as a launch partner amid Microsoft's print driver changes

email.body1:
Zachary, saw Tricerat brought on a new President and CEO and shipped ScrewDrivers 7.8, right as Microsoft's print driver changes give IT teams a reason to rethink their stack.

That timing opens more accounts worth reaching than reps can personally cover. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Tricerat off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Zachary, quick follow-up for Tricerat.

With a leadership change and the Microsoft driver shift as a catalyst, named accounts per rep climb, and most teams cannot say how many meetings they actually need to hit the number. The gap shows up late, then the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Tricerat needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Zachary, last bit of proof for Tricerat.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Tricerat's reply rate likely compares to similar B2B IT software teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Zachary, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding reps is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. A leadership transition is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to an IT-software motion? I will tailor it to Tricerat either way.
